run_maskformer_training: run the MaskFormer training script with a config file to train a segmentation model
run_maskformer_evaluation: run the MaskFormer evaluation script to test a trained model on a dataset
build_trainer_evaluator: build an evaluator for a given dataset using the Trainer class
build_trainer_train_loader: build a training data loader with a semantic or panoptic dataset mapper
build_trainer_optimizer: build an optimizer with gradient clipping for SGD or AdamW training
